scenes.heading: Retargeting: bringing back visitors who didn't convert

sents.d: Retargeting: bringing back visitors who didn't convert
Most first-time visitors don't buy — retargeting is how you stay in front of them without paying for a cold click again.

Retargeting ads (shown to people who already visited your site or engaged with content) typically convert at a meaningfully higher rate than cold traffic, because you're reminding an already-interested person rather than introducing yourself from scratch.

scenes.heading: A pixel and a small budget

sents.d: A simple setup — a pixel on your site feeding a small retargeting ad budget showing your best offer to recent visitors — is often worth testing before spending more on cold ad traffic, since the audience is warmer and cheaper to convert.
Cap how long someone stays in a retargeting audience (commonly 14-30 days); showing the same ad to someone for months tends to create fatigue or annoyance rather than more sales.

take: Retarget recent visitors briefly before spending on cold traffic.
